summary: community.general keycloak_component_info, keycloak_group, identity_provider, realm, realm_info, realm_key and realm_keys_metadata_info are now redirects requiring middleware_automation.keycloak.
questions: Does keycloak_realm still work from community.general in Ansible 15?

answer_card.title: Keycloak redirects in community.general (part 4)
answer_card.answer_md:
These community.general modules are now **redirects** to `middleware_automation.keycloak`. The redirect only works if you **install `middleware_automation.keycloak`**:

```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install middleware_automation.keycloak
```

Affected modules (each maps to `middleware_automation.keycloak.<name>`):

`keycloak_component_info`, `keycloak_group`, `keycloak_identity_provider`, `keycloak_realm`, `keycloak_realm_info`, `keycloak_realm_key`, `keycloak_realm_keys_metadata_info`
